name: OIDC Auth Provider
description: OpenID Connect auth provider. Works with Okta, Azure AD, Auth0, Google Workspace, and Keycloak via standard OIDC discovery.
author: OnePlatform

issuerUrl.description: OIDC issuer URL (e.g. https://dev-xxxxx.okta.com, https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant}/v2.0). Must host a /.well-known/openid-configuration document.

clientId.description: OAuth client ID registered with the identity provider.

scopes.description: OIDC scopes to request. 'openid' is always included.

roleClaimPath.description: Dot-delimited path to the roles claim in the ID token or userinfo response (e.g. 'groups', 'resource_access.myapp.roles'). Omit to disable role mapping.

roleMapping.description: Map of IdP role name → OnePlatform role name. Roles absent from this map are dropped.

jwksCacheTtlSeconds.description: How long to cache JWKS public keys. Increase for high-traffic deployments.

requiredCredentials.name: clientSecret
requiredCredentials.description: OAuth client secret for the confidential client. Required for the authorization code flow token exchange.
